title: REQ · A guard fails while any dependency path is tracked
summary: assertNoTrackedNodeModules throws listing tracked node_modules paths
description: Context: need a regression guard. Desired behavior: guard reads the tracked listing through the injected runner and throws an Error naming the offending paths when any exist. Why: fails the suite if node_modules is ever tracked again.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mocked listing with a node_modules path, when the guard runs, then it throws naming that path
Given a clean mocked listing, when the guard runs, then it resolves without error
technical_constraints: Uses the same injected runner as the cleanup
